response.diagnosis: The fixed sticky-promo overlays and intercepts clicks on the fixed Add to Cart button
response.evidenceSummary: Screenshot shows the bottom promo bar with no visible Add to Cart button. Hit tests at mobile, small, and desktop report add-to-cart in viewport but hitIsSelf=false with hitElement sticky-promo. In styles.css add-to-cart is fixed at bottom:16px with z-index:10, while sticky-promo is fixed at bottom:0, height:84px, z-index:20, covering the button area.
response.rationale: Moving the button to 100px from the bottom places it 16px above the 84px-high promo, preserving both elements while making the button visible and clickable.
